name: awe-tracegate
description: Offline, keyless skills for comparing agent changes and verifying evidence without trusting model output.

interface.shortDescription: Verify agent changes with replayable evidence.
interface.longDescription: Five focused skills for checking TraceGate readiness, comparing one measurable change, verifying exact evidence, integrating evaluation exports, and preparing redacted evidence for human review. The skills only orchestrate the offline TraceGate CLI; model or skill output is never verification evidence.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this repository is ready for TraceGate.
Compare this agent change with its frozen baseline.
Verify these evidence artifacts without executing them.
